facts.fact: Saskia 因铝制棒球棒弹在 Roger 头骨上的声音而充满凶猛的喜悦。
facts.anchor: The sound of an aluminum baseball bat bouncing off an asshole’s skull fills Saskia with ferocious joy.

facts.fact: Saskia 自 2020 年初见 Roger 的那一刻起就恨他。
facts.anchor: She has hated Roger since the moment she met him in 2020.

facts.fact: Saskia 按垒球里学过的样子完成挥棒，Roger 的头像钓到大鱼的钓竿一样猛地一甩。
facts.anchor: She completes her swing, just like they taught her in softball, and Roger’s head jerks like a fishing pole with something big on the line.

facts.fact: Lucy 后退一步、双手捂住嘴，说出那句「Oh my God」。
facts.anchor: “Oh my God,” Lucy says, stepping back, her hands over her mouth.

facts.fact: Saskia 站在他上方；他伸手去够手机，她把手机踢开。
facts.anchor: Saskia stands over him, and when he reaches for his phone, she kicks it away.

facts.fact: Roger 想站起来时，Saskia 又打了他一次，这一次正中嘴巴。
facts.anchor: When he tries to stand up, she hits him again, this time right in the mouth.

facts.fact: Saskia 一点也不后悔，但意识到自己会失去一个她刚学会去爱的女孩而胸口发紧，因为 Lucy 终于会明白她是个怪物。
facts.anchor: Saskia does not regret this, not a bit, but her chest goes tight as she realizes that she will lose a girl she was just learning how to love, because finally, finally Lucy will understand that she is a monster.

facts.fact: Saskia 伸出手，像想碰 Lucy，却像碰到她周围的一层力场。
facts.anchor: She holds her hands out like she wants to touch Lucy but has encountered a force field around her.

facts.fact: Lucy 只是摇了摇头，走进自己的卧室。
facts.anchor: In response, Lucy only shakes her head and walks into her bedroom.

facts.fact: 直到 Lucy 拿着大理石半身像重新出现，Saskia 都认定一切都完了。
facts.anchor: Saskia is certain that all is lost until Lucy reappears holding the marble bust.
